    def get_context(self):
        cfg = Config(
            SECURITY_KEY="ACME-SEC",
            ENGINE="thumbor.engines.pil",
            IMAGE_METADATA_READ_FORMATS="exif,xmp",
        )
        cfg.LOADER = "thumbor.loaders.file_loader"
        cfg.FILE_LOADER_ROOT_PATH = STORAGE_PATH
        cfg.STORAGE = "thumbor.storages.no_storage"

        return Context(config=cfg)

        self.context = self.get_context()

        engine = Engine(self.context)
        assert isinstance(engine, Engine)

    def test_load_image(self):
        engine = Engine(self.context)
        with open(join(STORAGE_PATH, "image.jpg"), "rb") as image_file:
            buffer = image_file.read()
        image = engine.create_image(buffer)
        assert image.format == "JPEG"
        assert engine.subsampling == 0

        engine = Engine(self.context)
        with open(join(STORAGE_PATH, "image.jp2"), "rb") as image_file:

        assert engine.subsampling is None

        assert engine.subsampling is None

    def test_should_preserve_png_transparency(self):
        engine = Engine(self.context)

        with open(
            join(STORAGE_PATH, "paletted-transparent.png"), "rb"
        ) as image_file:
            buffer = image_file.read()

        engine.load(buffer, "png")
        assert engine.original_mode == "P"
        engine.resize(200, 150)

        img = Image.open(BytesIO(engine.read(".png")))

        assert img.mode == "P"
        assert img.format.lower() == "png"

        transparent_pixels_count = sum(
            img.convert("RGBA")
            .split()[3]
            .point(lambda x: 0 if x else 1)
            .getdata()
        )
        assert transparent_pixels_count > 19000

    def test_should_preserve_png_transparency_after_grayscale(self):
        engine = Engine(self.context)

        with open(
            join(STORAGE_PATH, "paletted-transparent.png"), "rb"
        ) as image_file:
            buffer = image_file.read()

        engine.load(buffer, "png")
        assert engine.original_mode == "P"
        engine.resize(200, 150)
        # Leaves the image in LA mode, which quantize() does not accept
        engine.convert_to_grayscale()

        img = Image.open(BytesIO(engine.read(".png")))

        assert img.mode == "P"
        assert img.format.lower() == "png"

        # Every pixel must be grey, so that neither a no-op grayscale nor
        # colour reintroduced by the quantization goes unnoticed
        red, green, blue = img.convert("RGB").split()
        assert ImageChops.difference(red, green).getextrema()[1] == 0
        assert ImageChops.difference(green, blue).getextrema()[1] == 0

        transparent_pixels_count = sum(
            img.convert("RGBA")
            .split()[3]
            .point(lambda x: 0 if x else 1)
            .getdata()
        )

        assert transparent_pixels_count > 19000

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

# thumbor imaging service
# https://github.com/thumbor/thumbor/wiki

# Licensed under the MIT license:
# http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license

from io import BytesIO
from os.path import abspath, dirname, join

from PIL import Image

from thumbor.config import Config
from thumbor.context import Context
from thumbor.engines.pil import Engine

IMAGES_PATH = abspath(join(dirname(__file__), "../course/images"))
SIZE = (240, 160)


def load_source():
    with open(join(IMAGES_PATH, "sticker.gif"), "rb") as image_file:
        return image_file.read()


def resize_to_gif():
    config = Config(
        ENGINE="thumbor.engines.pil",
        ALLOW_ANIMATED_GIFS=False,
        PILLOW_PRESERVE_INDEXED_MODE=True,
    )
    engine = Engine(Context(config=config))
    engine.load(load_source(), ".gif")
    assert engine.original_mode == "P"
    engine.resize(*SIZE)
    return Image.open(BytesIO(engine.read(".gif")))


def alpha_of(image):
    return image.convert("RGBA").getchannel("A")


def count_transparent(alpha):
    return sum(1 for value in alpha.getdata() if value == 0)


def test_source_has_transparency():
    source = Image.open(BytesIO(load_source()))
    assert "transparency" in source.info
    assert count_transparent(alpha_of(source)) > 0


def test_resized_gif_carries_a_transparency_index():
    result = resize_to_gif()
    assert result.format == "GIF"
    assert result.size == SIZE
    assert "transparency" in result.info


def test_resized_gif_keeps_transparent_pixels_transparent():
    source = Image.open(BytesIO(load_source()))
    expected = alpha_of(source).resize(SIZE, Image.Resampling.NEAREST)
    result = alpha_of(resize_to_gif())

    expected_count = count_transparent(expected)
    assert expected_count > 0
    assert count_transparent(result) >= expected_count * 0.9
    assert result.getpixel((0, 0)) == expected.getpixel((0, 0)) == 0
    assert result.getpixel((SIZE[0] // 2, SIZE[1] // 2)) == 255
